Review your redirect map before the move

A local CSV preflight for SEO and website migration teams. Check structural problems, export a review report, and hand off candidate rules. Commercial disclosure: this product is sold by TinyToolsHub owner Jon Ireland.

Buy the offline edition — $29 once →

From CSV to an actionable review

  1. Try the free 25-row checker with a sample or your own CSV.
  2. For larger maps, buy the offline edition for $29 once. Checkout returns a private download page after successful payment.
  3. Unzip the product on a computer and open Redirect-Preflight.html in a desktop browser.
  4. Set your old and new site origins, load up to 20,000 rules / 5 MB, review findings, and export reports.
  5. Verify actual HTTP responses and destination relevance after deployment; CSV analysis cannot prove those results.

What is included

  • Self-contained desktop-browser checker for up to 20,000 rows / 5 MB.
  • Loops, contradictory destinations/statuses, chains, malformed URLs and duplicates flagged.
  • Review CSV, deduplicated candidate CSV and printable report.
  • Sample CSV and instructions, with no installation or subscription.

Limits and purchase terms

  • Your redirect CSV stays on your device. The checker does not upload client maps.
  • Conflicts, loops and invalid rules are excluded from candidate exports. Chains and unexpected origins require review.
  • Exact URLs and slash-prefixed paths are supported; wildcard rules and regex are not.
  • The license covers your business and client projects. No subscription or API credits. Full refund requests within 14 days; see the purchase terms.

A small example to check

source,target,status
/old-about,/about,301
/summer,/sale,301
/sale,/collections/sale,301
/loop-a,/loop-b,301
/loop-b,/loop-a,301
/contact-old,/contact,301
/contact-old,/support,301

The summer route is a chain; loop-a and loop-b form a loop; contact-old has competing destinations. The old-about rule has no structural issue in this sample, but the destination still needs live verification.
